entities.name: LuxO Q9KT84
observations: The provided 455-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q9KT84, LuxO from Vibrio cholerae.
LuxO is a cell-density-dependent response regulator that acts with sigma-54 to regulate transcription; curated annotations include phosphorelay signaling and ATP binding.
Sequence Pfam hits include response regulator, sigma-54 activator/AAA+ domains, and a C-terminal helix-turn-helix domain.

entities.name: Phosphorelay signaling
observations: LuxO is annotated to phosphorelay signal transduction (GO:0000160).

entities.name: Quorum sensing
observations: LuxO activity is regulated by cell density; in vibrios, phosphorylated LuxO with sigma-54 regulates low-cell-density transcription, including repression of luminescence genes in V. campbellii reference evidence.
